query:
SELECT landing_record_id AS "scan!: i64", weigh_in AS "weigh_in!: i64"
              FROM body_scan_weigh_in
             WHERE landing_record_id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?))
                OR landing_record_id IN (SELECT weigh_in FROM body_scan_part
                                          WHERE landing_record_id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?)))
